allowed_inputs: Phase1G language-train token stream (frequency only; no vocab construction in this study)
forbidden_actions: hand-add DEV names as special tokens

methods.A_NATIVE_GREEDY: reproduce T28 greedy exact+EOS on DEV (baseline)
methods.A_NATIVE_FREE_BEAM: inventory-free beam width 4, length-normalized sum logprob, stop at <eos>, max 12 new tokens, full 1024-way vocab
methods.A_CONSTRAINED_DEV_NAME_RERANK: teacher-forced mean logprob over the frozen 8 DEV answer names plus period; labeled NON-NATIVE / NOT the Phase 2A bar

metrics: language not rescored in this decode-only study
success_bar: shared-prefix exact must rise substantially without unique-prefix collapse; constrained rerank cannot be used to declare Phase 2A solved
